title: A local strictly perfect closed-pushforward model gives a bounded projective stalk complex
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $x\in Z$, and $U$ an open neighbourhood of $i(x)$. Let $K$ be a strictly perfect complex over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], and assume that in the derived category [def-pc-derived-category] it is isomorphic to the restriction of the ordinary pushforward $(i_*\mathcal O_Z)[0]$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,i(x)}$ and let $B=\mathcal O_{Z,x}$ be an $A$-module through $i^\sharp_x$. There is a cochain complex $L$ of $A$-modules indexed by $\mathbb Z$ such that (i) there exist integers $a,b$ with $L^j=0$ for $j<a$ or $b<j$; (ii) each $L^j$ is projective; (iii) $H^0(L)\cong B$ as $A$-modules; (iv) $H^j(L)=0$ for $j\ne0$. No nonpositive truncation or projective resolution is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Take the termwise stalk complex on the localized open-subspace site. Neighbourhoods contained in U are cofinal at i(x), so this stalk is over A and restriction to U does not change it. The bounds of K give bounds of its stalk complex L.

Stalks preserve finite coproducts and take the unit sheaf to the regular module over the stalk ring. Apply the stalk functor to the two finite-free retraction maps of each term. The stalk term is then a retract of a finite free A-module and is projective.

Exactness of the stalk functor makes it preserve quasi-isomorphisms and descend to the derived localization. Apply it to the specified derived isomorphism e. The stalk of the restricted single sheaf has homology only in degree zero.

Apply closedImmersion_pushforward_stalks to the unit sheaf. Its bijective germ map is linear through the stalk ring map and identifies the pushforward stalk with B. Compose it with the degree-zero homology identification to get H^0(L) isomorphic to B.

theorem strictPerfectClosedPushforward_stalkModel
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (x : Z) (U : Y.Opens) (hx : i x ∈ U)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hK : Y.IsStrictlyPerfect U K)
    (e : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) :
    ∃ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (i x))) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (L.X j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Projective (L.X j)) ∧
      Nonempty (L.homology 0 ≅
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (i.stalkMap x).hom).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (Z.presheaf.stalk x) (Z.presheaf.stalk x)))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → IsZero (L.homology j))
